tools.name: lookupStore
tools.description: Look up one ecommerce store by domain. The reply has company data, estimated revenue, marketing budget, traffic, Google and Meta ad spend, ad counts, a Conversion Rate Score, buying signals, the store phone number, and social and ad-library links. Decision-maker contact fields are not in the fields

tools.name: searchStores
tools.description: Search the store catalog like the Ecommerce Leads dashboard. Returns 30 rows per page. Stores you have not revealed show masked values for the hidden fields; revealed stores show the real values. By default, each row has storeId, 9 key columns (Industry, Country, revenue, Total Traffic, Google and M

tools.name: getStoreChart
tools.description: Get the latest 24 points of one metric for a store, for a chart. Values use your currency.

tools.name: listSignalSets
tools.description: List your signal sets, with the signal catalog and the ICP columns you can use in criteria. Paid plans only.

tools.name: getSignalSet
tools.description: Get one of your signal sets, with its criteria. Paid plans only.

tools.name: previewSignalSet
tools.description: Check whether candidate signal criteria match enough stores (80 or more). Returns {"enough": true|false}. It does not save anything. Paid plans only.

tools.name: listWatchlists
tools.description: List your watchlists and your blacklist, with the domain count of each. Paid plans only.

tools.name: getWatchlist
tools.description: Get the domains of one watchlist or the blacklist, 100 per page. To see store data for a watchlist, call searchStores with tab "watchlist:{id}". Paid plans only.

tools.name: getRevealCost
tools.description: Preview the credit cost of a reveal. Nothing is charged and nothing is revealed. Returns the cost of each action (details, ceo, marketing, ecommerce) for the selected stores.

tools.name: getRevealStatus
tools.description: Check the status of contact searches you started in the dashboard, and your credit balance. Read only.

tools.name: revealStores
tools.description: Reveal data for stores. THIS SPENDS CREDITS. Before you call it, call getRevealCost for the same selection and tell the user the cost, or state the cost of 1 credit per store, then ask the user to confirm. Never call it without the confirmation. details unlocks the profile links, buying signals and

tools.name: saveSignalSet
tools.description: Create a signal set, or replace the criteria of an existing one. Without setId it creates a new set (the plan limit applies). With setId it updates that set and replaces all its signals, legacy categories and ICP filters with the new criteria. Conditions that you did not set (saved custom SQL condit

tools.name: deleteSignalSet
tools.description: Delete one of your signal sets. The set stops matching stores and disappears from listSignalSets and from the dashboard tabs. You cannot undo this. Ask the user to confirm before you call it. Say the name of the set in your question. Paid plans only.

tools.name: createWatchlist
tools.description: Create an empty watchlist. You can have at most 10 lists, including the blacklist. Paid plans only.

tools.name: renameWatchlist
tools.description: Rename one of your watchlists. The blacklist cannot be renamed. Paid plans only.

tools.name: deleteWatchlist
tools.description: Delete one of your watchlists with all its domains. The blacklist cannot be deleted. Ask the user to confirm before you call it. Paid plans only.

tools.name: removeFromWatchlist
tools.description: Remove one domain from a watchlist or from the blacklist. Paid plans only.

tools.name: addToWatchlist
tools.description: Add domains to a watchlist (merge, nothing is removed). THIS SPENDS CREDITS: 1 credit per domain that is new to the list. Before you call it, tell the user the cost of 1 credit per store and how many domains you will add, then ask the user to confirm. Never call it without the confirmation. If you h

tools.name: updateOutreachStatus
tools.description: Set the outreach status of one store that you revealed. Use the storeId from a searchStores row. If you did not reveal the store, the tool returns an error. Use revealStores first. A store in a revealed group is accepted at no credit cost.

tools.name: sendFeedback
tools.description: Send a feedback message to the Ecommerce Leads team. Limit: 5 messages per hour.

tools.name: exportStores
tools.description: Export revealed stores as CSV text. Stores you have not revealed are skipped. The result holds the header row and at most 200 data rows; it says when it cut the rows. For a larger export, narrow the selection or download the file in the dashboard. Paid plans only.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "searchStores" is 1043 chars, far longer than this server's median (149). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.
